fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. God says, "And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you." (Exodus 25:16) Listen to those words, "which I will give you." Most of this passage is God telling people what to build, and here He says what He Himself will hand over.

Offerings do show up in this passage, baker. They're at the very start, where God asks the Israelites to bring Him an offering (Exodus 25:2). But for the place above the mercy seat, God says, "…I will meet with you there…" (Exodus 25:22) He adds that He will speak with Moses about all He commands regarding the Israelites.

Good thought, friend, but handwashing isn't what this verse says. The pitchers and bowls are for "…pouring drink offerings." and they're made of pure gold. (Exodus 25:29) The verse gives them one job, and it's the pouring. I'll admit I'd have guessed a wash-up too, since my mustache is always covered in flour.

The oil is on God's list at the very start, baker, where He asks for "olive oil for the light" (Exodus 25:6). But these pitchers and bowls are for "…pouring drink offerings." (Exodus 25:29) The lamps get their own piece of furniture, the lampstand, a few verses later.

Right, baker. God says, "And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times." (Exodus 25:30) Look at those two phrases, "before Me" and "at all times." The table is built to hold that bread in front of God without a break, and I'd love a steady job like that.

Good thought, baker, but tablets aren't mentioned anywhere in this passage. God says, "And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times." (Exodus 25:30) The Testimony has its own spot, inside the ark (Exodus 25:16). So the ark and the table each get their own thing.

That's the one, baker. God says, "Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it." (Exodus 25:37) Seven little lamps on one gold stand, all shining on the space in front of it. I spent years in a dark junk drawer, so trust me, a light in the room changes everything.
